body:
If you want to be whitelisted join the discord



💸 TAX EVASION SMP 💸
No rules? Nah… just the right ones.

Looking for an SMP that isn’t full of annoying restrictions and pay-to-win garbage?
Welcome to Tax Evasion SMP — where you can actually play the game.

🔥 What we offer:
• ⚔️ PvP anytime (fight when you want, no weird limits)
• 🏡 Build freely — no land-claiming nonsense
• 🎉 Chill vibes, active players, and real fun
• 💬 Hang out, make friends, or start chaos

🚫 What we DON’T do:
• No land claiming plugins
• No pay-to-win
• No over-the-top rules

✅ The only things we care about:
• No griefing
• No stealing
• Don’t be toxic

It’s all built on trust — mess that up, you’re gone.

💥 Whether you wanna grind, fight, build something insane, or just mess around with friends…
this is the server for it.

👉 Join now and start your (totally legal) empire. https://discord.gg/6uZSbUpvq7
